t: Mike Monteiro: F*ck You, Pay Me

q.x: Fuck you, pay me is a wonderful talk that should be required watching for any creative looking to start a career. Doubly so if striking out on their own. [link]

desc:
The most popular CreativeMornings talk of all time, Mike Monteiro gives us some valuable advice on how to get paid for the work that you do.

Mike Monteiro at the San Francisco chapter of CreativeMornings on Mar 25, 2011. 

Portions of this video have been edited for copyright purposes. If you would like to request the original version, please reach out to community @ creativemornings.com.

I can't stress to you enough how important the contract is, if you were thinking about a consulting style business you need to watch this before you dive in: [link]

If you want to learn about how a professional deals with contracts, payments, and contracting I'd say to check out "Fuck you. Pay me" [0] that gives a reasoned explanation of negotiations, what to expect, and reasonable ways to react/behave.
